summary: Iteration 66: Backend Route Extraction Regression Tests Complete. All 33 tests passed (100%). Verified that all endpoints in profile_routes.py, streak_routes.py, and payment_routes.py work correctly after extraction from server.py. server.py reduced from ~6058 to ~2700 lines.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend is React Native/Expo - cannot be tested via browser. Backend-only testing as requested.

GET /api/trainer-profiles/{user_id}.description: Returns trainer profile with userId, id, and all profile fields

GET /api/music/search?q=drake.description: iTunes proxy returns music search results

GET /api/trainee-profiles/{user_id}.description: Returns 404 if profile not created (expected behavior)

GET /api/leaderboard/weekly.description: Returns leaderboard array with user rankings

POST /api/payments/calculate-session-cos.description: Calculates session cost with sessionPrice and totals

GET /api/trainee/receipts.description: Returns receipts array and total count

GET /api/trainer/receipts.description: Returns receipts array and total count

GET /api/admin/trainers.description: Returns list of all trainers (admin only)

GET /api/admin/payouts/pending.description: Returns trainers list with pending balances
